decision_basis: Provider and model identities are not matched across treatment and native controls.
Hidden-oracle adjudication and receipt verification are not deterministic or content-addressed.
The frozen schedule permits incomplete released-fixture coverage and has no hard run budgets.
These are outcome-determining rule changes, and the frozen amendment policy requires a new protocol id.
next_protocol_requirements: provider-matched treatment and direct-native arm pairs
complete schedule binding for every released fixture
per-run and global token, dollar, and wall-time limits
content-addressed provider, runner, transcript, and adjudication receipts
